get.description:
Server-Sent Events: `state` on every change (queued, running), then `done`, `error` or `cancelled` with the
job, and the stream ends. An event's id is the rank of its state (queued 1, running 2, the end 3), the same on
every connection, so a reconnect with Last-Event-ID gets only what it missed.

the costs that apply. A field in error answers 422 problem+json: `errors` [{field, message}] with the dotted path,
and the members `form`, `bounds` and `costs` of the sheet without that field, so the form stays on screen.

everywhere.title: Everywhere
everywhere.description: end every session of this user, on every browser

permissions.title: Permissions

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token

names.title: Names

next.title: Next
next.description: the cursor of the next page, or null on the last one

quantity.title: Quantity

TradeUpdate.title: TradeUpdate

field.description: dotted path of the field at fault (coupon.barrier)

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; other members may follow (the term-sheet form adds its form)

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
